section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: A framed picture has a total area \(y\), in square inches. The thickness of the frame is represented by \(x\), in inches. The equation \(y = (2x + 8)(2x + 10)\) relates these two variables.

list.item: What is the width, or shorter side, of the picture without the frame?
What is the length, or longer side, of the picture without the frame?

div.para: The solution would represent the thickness of a frame that results in a total area of 100 square inches.

list.item: What would a solution to the equation \(100 = (2x + 8)(2x + 10)\) mean in this situation?
